sources.title: Piracy monthly report March 2025
sources.text: Four masked robbers armed with a gun and knives boarded a tanker underway and entered the engine room. The duty engine crew noticed the robbers and alerted the bridge officer, who raised the alarm, mustered the crew and notified VTIS. Upon hearing the alarm, the robbers escaped with stolen engine spares. On anchoring the coast guard boarded the vessel for investigations.
